description: This Kotlin source file defines the ViewModel for the Home screen in an Android TV application. It manages UI state for multiple article rails and banners, handles data loading via repositories, and exposes observable flows for UI consumption.

classes.name: RailState
classes.description: Data class representing UI state for a category rail, including title, loading status, error message, and list of content items.

classes.name: BannerState
classes.description: Data class representing UI state for the banner carousel, including loading status, error message, list of banners, and focused index.

classes.name: HomeViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel responsible for managing UI state of the home screen, including multiple category rails and banner carousel. Handles data fetching, state updates, and exposes observable flows.

methods.name: loadAll
methods.description: Initiates loading of all category rails and banners concurrently.

methods.name: reloadBanners
methods.description: Reloads the banners from the repository.

methods.name: setBannerFocusedIndex
methods.description: Saves the current focused banner index to preserve UI state across rotations.

methods.name: loadCategory
methods.description: Private method to fetch data for a specific category and update its state.

methods.name: loadBanners
methods.description: Private method to fetch banner data and update the banner state.
